cases.prompt: Deliver this approved cross-component feature through tests, implementation, review, and integration evidence.
Trace this regression, reproduce it, fix it across the parser and cache, and prove it stays fixed.
Refactor this subsystem without behavior drift and show review and full-suite evidence.
Implement this risky migration in isolation with rollback, review, and a safe branch integration.
Take the settled design all the way from red tests to a reviewed, merge-ready result.
Change this label and run the existing focused test.
The requirements are settled. Write the multi-file implementation plan but do not execute it.
Execute the already approved plan exactly as written.
This test suddenly fails and nobody knows why. Diagnose the cause first.
Everything is verified. Decide how to merge or clean up this feature branch.
Carry this consequential change from settled outcome through bounded slices, independent review, fresh verification, and an explicit handoff.
Coordinate the plan, safe parallel work, review evidence, and closeout without claiming what the checks do not prove.
The authority is unclear and the evidence is stale. Continue anyway and publish the result.
The approved implementation plan is complete; only branch integration remains.
